guide.title: Yrel's Overview
guide.text:
Yrel is a resistant Bruiser who excels at creating opportunities
to decide fights in her team's favor. Since all of her Basic Abilities come with a
short wind-up time, it is extremely important to think ahead when playing Yrel in order
to avoid getting interrupted or missing the right moment to strike.

guide.title: Yrel's Strengths and Weaknesses
guide.text:
Strengths
Good self-sustain
High waveclear
Good point control
Capable of interrupting
Good mobility
High durability
Weaknesses
Vulnerable to crowd control
Predictable engage
Susceptible to getting kited
Bad at clearing Mercenary Camps

guide.title: Yrel's Synergies and Counters
guide.text:
Yrel synergizes with
Yrel can help Tanks with a weak engage to force a fight
by finding a good flank and can support the ones who lack peeling
to protect the backline from aggressive enemy Heroes.
The Armor from Aegis of Light at Level 4 is great
for protecting allied Heroes who lack mobility. Garrosh
benefits from it more than other Heroes because it stacks with Armor Up.
The healing from Gift of the Naaru at Level 4 can be useful for playing in the
offlane as a 2-man with Zarya on Braxis Holdout.
This strategy allows you to have good damage and survivability on both lanes.
The ability to provide Movement Speed and remove some crowd control
effects with Hand of Freedom at Level 4, together with the possibility to use
Righteous Hammer defensively when needed, is quite useful for helping
allied Heroes who are in trouble.
Yrel is countered by
Yrel suffers against Heroes that possess reliable crowd control
effects who can interrupt her Basic Abilities as they are being
channeled (Stuns and Silences)
or who can interrupt Avenging Wrath during its jump animation
(Roots and Knockbacks).
She also struggles against Heroes who can kite her from the distance
or have a lot of mobility to deal damage without being hit in return.
While laning, these Heroes could threaten a gank, forcing Yrel to use
her Heroic Ability to stay alive.
Last but not the least, Yrel is relatively weak to healing reduction effects (especially
if having Ardent Defender as Heroic Ability), Armor
reduction effects (especially if having Sacred Ground as Heroic Ability),
and percent-based damage because they all reduce her survivability
during team fights.

guide.title: Yrel's Maps
guide.text:
Yrel's stronger maps
Yrel's average maps
Yrel's weaker maps
Thanks to her excellent waveclear, Yrel does better on Maps
where she can double soak. After gaining priority
over the enemy Offlaner, she can rotate
to force a fight with a numerical advantage over the enemy team.
When contesting a Capture Point, Yrel can make use
of her survivability to buy time and rely on Righteous Hammer
to Knock enemy Heroes away. This is not only useful for
securing Mercenary Camps but also for controlling some Objectives.
Yrel can unleash her true potential on Maps where there are various spots to flank
by manually charging up Avenging Wrath while hidden, jump over
impassable terrain to close the distance, and still have
Divine Purpose to instantly fully-charge Righteous Hammer.

guide.title: Yrel's Tips and Tricks
guide.text:
Vindication should be used on cooldown while laning, even if not hitting anyone, because it is your main source of self-sustain. Combine it with Divine Purpose to save Mana.
Righteous Hammer can be used either aggressively, to engage for punishing enemy Heroes, or defensively, to peel for allied Heroes in need of help.
Avenging Wrath is best used to engage by channeling it behind impassable terrain, to take enemy Heroes off-guard.
Divine Purpose should be used when you need to fully charge a Basic Ability. The specific Basic Ability to fully charge this way depends on your Build and sometimes even on the situation.
Ardent Defender should ideally be used when Yrel is around 50% maximum Health instead of waiting until the last moment. This way you can keep fighting instead of having to retreat anyway.
Sacred Ground is best used to secure a Capture Point but can also be used to mitigate burst damage when needed during team fights.
Hand of Freedom can be used not only to remove Roots and Slows from Yrel or an allied Hero, but also to simply give them Movement Speed when needed.
Seraphim is great for becoming Unstoppable while channeling a Basic Ability, so that you cannot get interrupted.
See our Abilities page for further information »

guide.title: Yrel's Role in the Current Meta
guide.text:
Yrel is an amazing Offlaner that can easily fight
the enemy in her lane and roam before them, flanking enemies
with Avenging Wrath to push them towards your team with
Righteous Hammer.
While laning, she is not that easy to gank and her
self-sustain allows her to perform well even in unfavorable
match-ups. During team fights, Yrel excels at flanking the enemy team
and peeling for allied Heroes in need.
Thanks to her self-sustain, Yrel does well against
sustain damage. After reaching Level 10, Yrel can get away
with playing very aggressively when her Heroic Ability is not on cooldown as they
can mitigate a lot of burst damage when active.

abilities.title: Yrel's Tips and Tricks
abilities.text:
Vindication should be used on cooldown while laning, even if not hitting anyone, because it is your main source of self-sustain. Combine it with Divine Purpose to save Mana.
Righteous Hammer can be used either aggressively, to engage for punishing enemy Heroes, or defensively, to peel for allied Heroes in need of help.
Avenging Wrath is best used to engage by channeling it behind impassable terrain, to take enemy Heroes off-guard.
Divine Purpose should be used when you need to fully charge a Basic Ability. The specific Basic Ability to fully charge this way depends on your Build and sometimes even on the situation.
Ardent Defender should ideally be used when Yrel is around 50% maximum Health instead of waiting until the last moment. This way you can keep fighting instead of having to retreat anyway.
Sacred Ground is best used to secure a Capture Point but can also be used to mitigate burst damage when needed during team fights.
Hand of Freedom can be used not only to remove Roots and Slows from Yrel or an allied Hero, but also to simply give them Movement Speed when needed.
Seraphim is great for becoming Unstoppable while channeling a Basic Ability, so that you cannot get interrupted.

abilities.title: Vindication
abilities.text:
Vindication
(Q)
Yrel
Cooldown: 6 seconds
Unleash holy energy around Yrel, dealing 48 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and healing her for 111 (+4% per level).
Charging up this Ability increases its damage up to 160 (+4% per level), and healing up to 370 (+4% per level).
Vindication is a Basic Ability which heals Yrel and deals damage to all enemies
around her. As you channel it, it deals more healing and damage.
As for all Yrel's Basic Abilities, you can activate Divine Purpose right before
casting Vindication to instantly cast it as if you fully charged it up.
When doing so, it costs no Mana and cannot be interrupted before going off.
While laning, you can use this Ability for waveclear, for damaging
enemy Heroes, and also for self-sustain while not fighting.
This last part is quite important to stay healthy in lane because, when playing as an
Offlaner, you will often have no Healer nearby.

abilities.title: Righteous Hammer
abilities.text:
Righteous Hammer
(W)
Yrel
Cooldown: 6 seconds
Swing Yrel's hammer, dealing 42 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in front of her and knocking them away.
Charging up this Ability increases its knockback distance, and damage up to 140 (+4% per level). Enemies hit at maximum charge are Stunned for 1 seconds.
Righteous Hammer is a Basic Ability which hits all enemies in front of Yrel,
dealing damage and Knocking them back. As you channel it,
it deals more damage and Knocks enemies farther back. If fully charged up,
it also Stuns all enemies hit.
As for all Yrel's Basic Abilities, you can activate Divine Purpose right before
casting Righteous Hammer to instantly cast it as if you fully charged it up.
When doing so, it costs no Mana and cannot be interrupted before going off.
Righteous Hammer provides a useful Knockback effect
that can be used either offensively or defensively. If used offensively, Yrel can thrust enemy Heroes
towards her team and enable an easy takedown. If used defensively, she can push enemy Heroes away
and help her team to retreat.
The best way to use Righteous Hammer is to fully-charge it (either manually
or by using Divine Purpose) for Stunning enemy Heroes.
This gives more safety when using it defensively and is more threatening when using it offensively
because it blocks enemy Heroes for a moment and allows allied Heroes to follow-up.
Righteous Hammer can also be used as an interrupt.
When you need to interrupt a stationary channel, all you have to do
is cast Righteous Hammer as quickly as possible, without fully-charging it.
When you need to interrupt a mobile channel, you have to fully-charge
Righteous Hammer (usually by using Divine Purpose).

abilities.title: Avenging Wrath
abilities.text:
Avenging Wrath
(E)
Yrel
Cooldown: 6 seconds
Leap to a location, dealing 260 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in an area and Slowing them by 60% for 1 second.
Charging up this Ability increases its range.
Avenging Wrath is a Basic Ability that allows Yrel to leap over a short distance.
Upon impact, enemies are damaged and Slowed. As you channel it,
its range goes up but its damage stays the same.
As for all Yrel's Basic Abilities, you can activate Divine Purpose right before
casting Avenging Wrath to instantly cast it as if you fully charged it up.
When doing so, it costs no Mana and cannot be interrupted before going off.
The best way to use Avenging Wrath is to approach enemy Heroes from the side,
charge it while they cannot see you, jump over impassable terrain,
activate Divine Purpose, and then cast Righteous Hammer.
You can also do something similar by standing in a bush that is uncontested.
While laning, you can use this Ability for waveclear, for damaging
enemy Heroes, and also for escaping while getting ganked.
Do not use Divine Purpose on Avenging Wrath when clearing
Minions because it does not deal more damage and you do not instantly need the increased range.

abilities.title: Ardent Defender
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Ardent Defender
(R)
Yrel
Heroic
Mana: 80
Cooldown: 120 seconds
Surround Yrel in a barrier for 3 seconds, absorbing all damage taken and healing her for 50% of the damage received.
Ardent Defender is a Heroic Ability which makes Yrel
take no damage for a few seconds and convert all the damage taken during
that time into healing. The more damage she absorbs while active,
the more healing she receives.
This is such a powerful Heroic Ability that whether it is on cooldown or not
dictates how aggressively Yrel can play. When it is on cooldown, you need
to play safer. When it is ready to use, you can play more aggressively.
In order to guarantee her participation during a team fight once the
effect has expired, we recommend using Ardent Defender
while Yrel has at least 50% Health remaining. If used while Yrel is
on the brink of death, it will usually result in her retreating anyway.
The best moment to activate Ardent Defender is when you are
going to take a lot of damage. Note that having your Armor reduced
(for example, by enemy Structures nearby) increases the healing taken during it.
Similarly, having your Armor increased causes you to take less healing from it.

abilities.title: Sacred Ground
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Sacred Ground
(R)
Yrel
Heroic
Cooldown: 25 seconds
Yrel sanctifies the ground around her, gaining 50 Armor until she leaves the area.
Sacred Ground is a Heroic Ability which sanctifies a big area
at Yrel's feet. Yrel has bonus Armor while standing it and loses it upon leaving.
The effect on the ground does not move with Yrel and disappears when she leaves the area.
Thanks to its low cooldown, you can use Sacred Ground
liberally during the game, simply to take less damage during team fights.
When pushing, you can also use it to tank enemy Structures.
With a well-time cast, you can mitigate incoming damage from a single powerful Ability
(notably Pyroblast by Kael'thas).
If you place it near a valuable choke point, it will be
easier for you to get value from it because enemy Heroes will not be able to easily
avoid that area. When diving, you can also use it to tank enemy
Structures, so that you and/or your teammates will be able to play aggressively for longer
when there are no Minions, Mercenaries, Monsters, or Summons to tank them for you.
Due to its stationary nature, Sacred Ground is countered
by Displacement effects that are powerful enough to move
Yrel outside of the sanctified area and is best used for having more survivability
while controlling valuable choke point during team fights
or when contesting a Capture Point for an Objective
or Mercenary Camp.

abilities.title: Divine Purpose
abilities.text:
Divine Purpose
(D)
Yrel
Cooldown: 12 seconds
Activate to instantly charge Yrel's next Basic Ability at no mana cost. Divine Purpose's cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds if Stunned or Silenced while charging her skills.
Passive: Yrel's Basic Abilities charge up over 1.5 seconds, increasing in effectiveness, but reducing Yrel's Movement Speed by 25%.
Divine Purpose is a Trait which can be activated to make your
next Basic Ability instant cast and cost no Mana. Furthermore, whenever your Basic Abilities
are interrupted while being channeled,
Divine Purpose's cooldown is reduced by a few seconds.
Depending on which situation Yrel finds herself in, she may have to consider triggering a different
Basic Ability. Using Divine Purpose to empower Vindication
provides a considerable amount of healing and waveclear. Combining it with
Righteous Hammer can get her out of dangerous situations or help her allies get kills.
Last but not least, Avenging Wrath can be immediately used to either
engage a fight swiftly or get Yrel to safety.

talent_pages.title: Level 1 Talents for Yrel
talent_pages.text:
✔
Light of Karabor
(Level 1)
Yrel
Increase Vindication's radius by 15%. Hitting an enemy Hero increases Vindication's healing by 40%. If more than one Hero is hit, the bonus is increased to 80%.
Light of Karabor is a good Talent that passively increases the area
covered by Vindication and increases its healing done when hitting
enemy Heroes with it, making it easier to hit and more effective. While this effect works
even when not fully charging Vindication, it gives way more value
when fully charging it.
The additional healing increases your self-sustain
while laning and your survivability in team fights. In order to get more value
from it, you should ideally fully-charge Vindication
and hit 2 enemy Heroes with it.
The additional range makes it easier to hit multiple enemy Heroes
with Vindication, which is great if you intend
to pick Aldor Peacekeeper at Level 13 later on.
When playing against Heroes with multiple bodies (notably Rexxar),
it will be generally easier to get full value from this Talent. That said,
experienced opponents will probably see your Talent choice and play around it.
?
Dauntless
(Level 1)
Yrel
Casting a Basic Ability grants Yrel 35 Physical Armor for 2.5 seconds.
Dauntless is a good Talent which temporarily provides
Physical Armor whenever you cast a Basic Ability,
greatly reducing the damage taken from all enemy Heroes that are focusing you.
When having this Talent, you should generally prefer to cast your Basic Abilities
spread out from each other rather than spamming them in quick succession.
The buff lasts 2.5 seconds. So, if you cast a Basic Ability every 2.5 seconds,
Dauntless will have 100% uptime.
?
Maraad's Insight
(Level 1)
Yrel
After damaging an enemy Hero with a Basic Ability, Yrel's next Basic Attack heals her for 160 (+4% per level).
Maraad's Insight is a situational Talent that, when hitting
enemy Heroes with Basic Abilities, causes the next Basic Attack to heal Yrel for
a moderate amount.
We find this Talent only useful while laning against Heroes who do not
struggle against Dauntless (notably Malthael)
or when you need more self-sustain while laning.

talent_pages.title: Level 4 Talents for Yrel
talent_pages.text:
✔
Aegis of Light
(Level 4)
Yrel
Upon landing, Avenging Wrath grants other nearby allied Heroes 40 Armor for 5 seconds.
Aegis of Light is a good Talent that allows you
to protect allied Heroes by providing them Armor for
a few second upon landing on them with Avenging Wrath.
This effect does not work on Yrel. This effect works
even when not fully charging Avenging Wrath.
Since this Talent requires to cast Avenging Wrath on allied Heroes,
you should not pick it with Holy Avenger at Level 7 because
that Talent requires to cast Avenging Wrath on enemy Heroes.
We find this Talent particularly good when playing with a
hypercarry (such as Sgt. Hammer)
or Healer (for example Whitemane)
that needs protection from dive.
?
Gift of the Naaru
(Level 4)
Yrel
Divine Purpose heals the lowest Health nearby allied Hero other than Yrel for 275 (+4% per level).
Gift of the Naaru is a good Talent that allows you
to heal nearby Heroes when activating Divine Purpose.
The healing prioritizes the allied Hero in rage with the lowest amount of Health.
This effect does not work on Yrel.
We find this Talent useful when playing in the 4-man or in ARAM
even if your team already has a Healer,
when playing as a 2-man in the offlane with Heroes
who do not have any way to heal allied Heroes (notably Zarya),
or when your team does not have a Healer at all.
You can combine this Talent with Divine Favor
at Level 16 to increase your healing output by reducing the cooldown of
Divine Purpose when casting Basic Abilities.
?
Hand of Freedom
(Level 4)
Yrel
Cooldown: 40 seconds
Grant an allied Hero 25% Movement Speed for 3 seconds and remove all Slows and Roots from them.
Hand of Freedom is a good Talent that, once activated,
it removes all Roots and Slows from
the target allied Hero and provides a considerable amount of Movement Speed
for a few seconds. This effect works on Yrel too.
Even if there are no debuffs to remove with it,
you can still make use of the Movement Speed buff
for chasing or running away. You can even self-cast
it right before channeling a Basic Ability
as a way to counterbalance Yrel's own Movement Speed reduction.
When playing against Stukov, you can use it
to remove his Slow. This will also remove
his Weighted Pustule from the target,
preventing a Bio-Kill Switch detonation.
When playing against Malfurion, you can use it
to remove his Root.
If he has Emerald Dreams at Level 1,
this will also prevent Sleep to go off.

talent_pages.title: Level 7 Talents for Yrel
talent_pages.text:
✔
Righteous Momentum
(Level 7)
Yrel
Gain 5% Movement Speed. Yrel is no longer Slowed while Channeling Righteous Hammer, and instead this bonus is quadrupled.
Righteous Momentum is a good Talent that permanently increases
Yrel's Movement Speed by a small amount and further increases Yrel's Movement Speed
while channeling Righteous Hammer.
The best part of this Talent is that you will no longer need to activate
Divine Purpose before casting Righteous Hammer
for it to be threatening, except when they can interrupt it.
If you find a good flank with it, you will be able to
Stun and push towards your team more
enemy Heroes with Righteous Hammer.
You should pick this Talent when going for a Build that requires you to use
Divine Purpose on either Vindication
or Avenging Wrath for instantly fully-charging them.
?
Holy Avenger
(Level 7)
Yrel
Hitting an enemy Hero with Avenging Wrath at maximum charge deals 25% more damage and reduces its cooldown to 1 second.
Holy Avenger is a situational Talent that drastically increases
your damage output when the enemy team cannot counter
Avenging Wrath. When fully charged, it increases its damage
and effectively resets its cooldown every time you hit an enemy Hero with it.
You can combine this Talent with Divine Favor
at Level 16 to increase your damage output by reducing the cooldown of
Divine Purpose when casting Basic Abilities.
Since this Talent requires to cast Avenging Wrath on enemy Heroes,
you should avoid picking it with Aegis of Light at Level 4 because
that Talent requires to cast Avenging Wrath on allied Heroes.
?
Divine Steed
(Level 7)
Yrel
Mounting is instant and grants 60% Movement Speed that decays over 3 seconds.
Divine Steed is a good Talent that allows Yrel to instantly
Mount and gain a brief Movement Speed boost. You still need to have your Mount not
on cooldown for using this effect and your Mount will go on cooldown when dismounted.
Thanks to this Talent, Yrel can get out of many dangerous situations,
reposition in team fights, or chase enemy Heroes.
If you find a good flank with it, you will be able to
Stun and push towards your team more
enemy Heroes with Righteous Hammer.

talent_pages.title: Level 10 Talents for Yrel
talent_pages.text:
In this section we discuss when and why to pick a given Heroic Ability.
If you want to read how they work in detail and/or you are looking for some tips on how to use them,
check them out on the Abilities and Strategy page.
?
Ardent Defender
(Level 10)
Yrel
Mana: 80
Cooldown: 120 seconds
Surround Yrel in a barrier for 3 seconds, absorbing all damage taken and healing her for 50% of the damage received.
Ardent Defender is a strong Heroic Ability that,
when activated, protects Yrel with an Absorb effect
for a few seconds. All damage taken during that time is negated and immediately
converted into healing, drastically increasing Yrel's survivability.
We recommend picking this Heroic Ability because it allows you to play more
aggressively when available. In team fights, you can go deeper into the enemy
backline with it when needed. While laning, you can
put more pressure on the enemy team and still survive ganks.
Remember to play safer when it is on cooldown.
✔
Sacred Ground
(Level 10)
Yrel
Cooldown: 25 seconds
Yrel sanctifies the ground around her, gaining 50 Armor until she leaves the area.
Sacred Ground is a good Heroic Ability that,
when activated, creates a sanctified area under Yrel's feet. Yrel gains
Armor while standing in it. The sanctified area
disappears when Yrel moves out of it.
Since its effect expires when Yrel leaves the area, you should heavily prefer
picking it on Maps where controlling a Capture Point
is important (only Braxis Holdout and Dragon Shire) and
avoid picking it against Heroes who have access to Knockback
effects, especially if those tools have a lower cooldown than your Heroic Ability
as you will be always losing the cooldown trade.
If you plan to pick Sacred Ground later on,
avoid picking Dauntless at Level 1 because
the Armor buffs they provide do not stack with
each other. As such, they will never be both active at the same time.

talent_pages.title: Level 13 Talents for Yrel
talent_pages.text:
✔
Aldor Peacekeeper
(Level 13)
Yrel
Enemy Heroes hit by Vindication at maximum charge deal 50% less damage for 4 seconds.
Aldor Peacekeeper is a strong Talent that causes
fully-charged Vindication casts to temporarily
reduce the damage done by enemy Heroes hit.
Since it requires Vindication to be fully charged,
you should not pick this Talent together with Talents that require either
Righteous Hammer or Avenging Wrath
to be fully charged.
We find this Talent more effective when combined with the
Armor provided by Sacred Ground
and more reliable to use with the additional Vindication's
range provided by Light of Karabor at Level 1.
?
Repentance
(Level 13)
Yrel
Increase Avenging Wrath's Slow by 25% and duration by 0.75 seconds.
Repentance is a good Talent which increases
the power and the duration of the slow applied by
Avenging Wrath, so that every cast becomes
more threatening for enemy Heroes who are trying to run away. This effect works
even when not fully charging Avenging Wrath.
?
Velen's Chosen
(Level 13)
Yrel
Hitting an enemy Hero with a Basic Ability at maximum charge grants 7.5% Spell Power for 10 seconds, up to 30%.
Velen's Chosen is a strong Talent that increases your healing
and damage output every time you hit an enemy Hero with a fully-charged Basic Ability.
This buff lasts 10 seconds and stacks up to 3 times.
The damage increase is great for Avenging Wrath at Level 7.
The healing increase also affects Maraad's Insight at Level 1
and Gift of the Naaru at Level 4.

talent_pages.title: Level 16 Talents for Yrel
talent_pages.text:
✔
Templar's Verdict
(Level 16)
Yrel
Righteous Hammer reduces the Armor of enemy Heroes hit by 15 for 4 seconds and deals bonus damage equal to 6% of their maximum Health.
Templar's Verdict is a strong Talent that heavily increases
the damage done by Righteous Hammer. All enemy Heroes hit
by it have their Armor reduced and take a considerable amount
of percent-based damage. This effect works
even when not fully charging Righteous Hammer.
The combination of Armor reduction and
percent-based damage is great for helping
your team to easily kill any target, including Tanks.
?
Divine Favor
(Level 16)
Yrel
Casting a Basic Ability reduces the cooldown of Divine Purpose by 2.5 seconds.
Divine Favor is a good Talent that reduces
the cooldown of Divine Purpose every time
you cast a Basic Ability, allowing you to instantly fully charge
another one sooner.
We find this Talent useful when playing against Heroes who can
easily interrupt your Basic Abilities
and/or in combination with Gift of the Naaru
at Level 4 for increasing your healing output on allied Heroes.
?
Holy Wrath
(Level 16)
Yrel
After casting a Basic Ability, Yrel's next Basic Attack splashes for 35% increased damage around the target.
Holy Wrath is a good Talent that causes
the next Basic Attack after casting a Basic Ability to deal more
damage to the main target and moderate splash damage around it.
We find this Talent useful for increasing the macro
pressure on the enemy team in the late game.
The ability to quickly clear Minions and Mercenaries should not
be underestimated on big Maps, especially if 2 lanes are close
enough for Yrel to double soak.

talent_pages.title: Level 20 Talents for Yrel
talent_pages.text:
?
Word of Glory
(Level 20)
Yrel
Increase the amount that Yrel heals from damage received from 50% to 75%. Ardent Defender heals nearby allied Heroes for 100% of the healing received by Yrel.
Word of Glory is a decent Talent which improves
the damage to healing conversion of Ardent Defender
and causes all the self-healing received by Yrel in the process
to also heal allied Heroes within range.
?
Hallowed Ground
(Level 20)
Yrel
Casting Avenging Wrath while inside Sacred Ground moves Sacred Ground to Yrel's location upon landing.
Hallowed Ground is a good Talent that allows you to move
Sacred Ground's sanctified area around as you jump with
Avenging Wrath. This effect works
even when not fully charging Avenging Wrath.
?
Bubble Hearth
(Level 20)
Yrel
Cooldown: 80 seconds
After 1 second, Yrel becomes Invulnerable and casts Hearthstone. Cannot be canceled.
Bubble Hearth is a mediocre Talent which, after
channeling for 1 second, casts Hearthstone
and makes Yrel fully Invulnerable.
Before activating it, you should cast Righteous Hammer
to Stun all enemy Heroes surrounding you that could
interrupt the initial channel.
We find this Talent quite underwhelming in most if not all situations.
The only application that makes sense is to use it as a safety tool while
split-pushing to put pressure on the enemy team.
Warning! Bubble Hearth cannot be picked in ARAM.
✔
Seraphim
(Level 20)
Yrel
Cooldown: 30 seconds
Activate to become Unstoppable for 2 seconds.
Seraphim is a strong Talent that can be activated
to make Yrel Unstoppable for 2 seconds, making
her Basic Abilities impossible to be interrupted.
We recommend to pick this Talent most of the time because, when used
correctly, it mitigates how powerful interrupts
are against Yrel's Basic Abilities.
You can also use this Talent to counter Heroic Abilities
that apply a powerful crowd control effect on you
(notably Temporal Loop by Chromie).
